entries.document: Electro-Voice Zx3 Series Owner’s Manual (covers Zx3-60, Zx3-90, Zx3-60PI, Zx3-90PI). Author: Electro-Voice (manufacturer). Host eviaudio.fr homepage names EVI AUDIO FRANCE, a professional audio distributor of Electro-Voice.
entries.evidence: Features: "DVX3121 12” woofer"; "ND2 2” voice coil, 1” exit neodymium compression driver" (two drivers). Specifications: LF transducer DVX3121 12 in, HF transducer ND2 1 in; "Power Handling (Passive)" and "Passive Mode" block diagram; "Passive and biamp selectable". Axial Sensitivity 97 dB (1W/1m), half-space measurement. Applies to both Zx3-60 and Zx3-90 (shared specification table).

fieldResults.note: manual spec table lists LF DVX3121 12 in and HF ND2 1 in compression driver = 2 transducers.
manual states passive mode and biamp selectable; power handling (Passive) listed first; no integrated amplifier.
shared Zx3 specification table, same 2 transducers (coverage 90x50 differs only).

entries.document: PreSonus R65 and R80 Active AMT Studio Monitors Owner’s Manual. Author: PreSonus (copyright line names PreSonus Audio Electronics, Inc.). Host fmicassets.com: owner-confirmed PreSonus document host (2026-10-13).
entries.evidence: "2-way active AMT studio monitor with DSP"; "self-powered"; "Class D biamped power configuration: 100W LF, 50W HF". LF driver: R65 6.5 in woven composite, R80 8 in woven composite; HF driver: AMT 6.8 in2 (equivalent 3 in). Both models named in the same manual with R65 and R80 specification rows. Host www.fmicassets.com: owner confirmed on 2026-10-13 that it is PreSonus's document host (homepage fetch returned HTTP 500, so the operator was not read from the host itself).

fieldResults.note: content supports 2 drivers (LF + AMT HF). Promoted on owner-confirmed PreSonus host (2026-10-13).
